title: Asking about a trip

fn.en: Ask someone about their last trip and say what did not happen.

useful: Did you have a good time?

sub.en: Look at the sentences. What form is the verb after did and didn’t?

items.q: I ___ to the beach — the weather was terrible.
items.why: didn’t + the base form. The past is already in did.

rows: We didn’t have a good time.

She didn’t stay in a hotel

Why did he go to Guatemala

lines: “So you [went|did go|goed] to Guatemala? Why [did|do|were] you go there?”
“Because it’s a really interesting country. I [wanted|want|did wanted] to see the Mayan temples.”
“[Did|Do|Were] you stay in hotels?” — “No, I [didn’t|don’t|wasn’t]. Mostly guest houses.”
“[Did|Was|Were] you go on your own?” — “Yes, I [did|was|went], but I met lots of local people.”

tts: Hey, Tom. So you went to Guatemala on holiday this time? Where is it exactly? It’s in Central America, to the south of Mexico. Why did you go there? Because it’s a really interesting country. I wanted to go sightseeing and see some of the famous ruined Mayan cities and temples. And whereabouts in Guatemala did you go? I visited the whole country. I started in Antigua — it’s the historic capital — and then I went to Lake Atitlán, a beautiful lake in the mountains. So what did you do and see? I went on lots of tours, and I went trekking in the rainforest.

acts.title: The trip I didn’t enjoy
text: Last summer I went to the coast with two friends. We wanted a quiet week on the beach.
It rained for four days. We didn’t swim once and we didn’t see the sun until Friday.
On the second day we got lost in the old town and we walked for two hours. We didn’t have a map.
The museum was closed, so we didn’t see it. In the end we stayed in the hotel and played cards.
Did I have a good time? Not really — but the food was excellent and my friends were very funny.

items.s: They went to the coast with friends.
They got lost in the old town.

write.q: Write about your last trip: 6 sentences. Say where you went, how long you stayed, two things you did — and two things you did NOT do.
write.model: Last summer I went to Turkey with my family. We stayed for ten days in a small hotel near the beach. We went sightseeing in the old town and we ate in a different restaurant every evening. We didn’t visit the museum, because it was closed. We didn’t get lost once — my sister had a map. It was a great trip.

speak.q: Interview a partner out loud: Where did you go? Why did you go there? How long did you stay? Did you have a good time? Then answer the same four questions yourself.
speak.model: Where did you go? — I went to Georgia. Why did you go there? — Because the mountains are beautiful. How long did you stay? — Ten days. Did you have a good time? — Yes, I did!
